entities.summary: Gleisi Helena Hoffmann is a Brazilian lawyer and a member of the Chamber of Deputies of Brazil, currently on leave. She is the Chief Minister of the Secretariat of Institutional Relations of the Government of President Luis Inácio Lula da Silva. Previously, from 2011 to 2014, she served as the Chief of Staff of the Government of President Dilma Rousseff. In 2017 she was elected a Senator for Paraná before becoming national president of the Workers' Party, which she led for eight years.
